title: Bug 640958: Guided error for subcontracting direct transfer from whse-handling location
summary: The subcontracting transfer order creation report now provides a guided error when attempting direct transfer from a warehouse-handling location without an in-transit route, instead of an obscure system error.
key_points: Added CheckDirectTransferAllowed method to validate direct transfer feasibility before setting the field
Raises a guided error suggesting either setting up an in-transit route or using Direct Transfer posting
Handles the case where source location requires pick or shipment but direct transfer is not configured
Includes a negative test case to verify the error handling
